html:
A bank founded in Hong Kong in 1865 as the Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation, to finance the growing trade between China and the West. It is now one of the largest banks in the world.

Its founder, the Scottish shipping man Thomas Sutherland, wanted a bank run locally rather than from London or India. It opened in Hong Kong and Shanghai in 1865. It financed the tea, silk and later opium trade, issued Hong Kong's banknotes and lent to the Qing government, often against its customs revenue. Its tower on the Hong Kong waterfront became a symbol of the colony.

After the communist victory in 1949 it lost most of its mainland business. It grew by buying banks abroad, above all Midland Bank in Britain in 1992, and moved its head office to London before Hong Kong's return to China in 1997. Today it still issues most Hong Kong banknotes and is caught between Britain and China, its two main markets.
sum: A bank founded in Hong Kong in 1865 as the Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation, to finance the growing trade between China and the West. It is now one of the largest banks in the world.
